FluxDrop for Windows 0.4.0-dev

Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime: MIT and third-party notices, distributed self-contained with LICENSE.txt and ThirdPartyNotices.txt in the application folder. https://github.com/dotnet/runtime
PDFsharp-WPF 6.2.4: MIT; pinned version. https://github.com/empira/PDFsharp/tree/v6.2.4
Markdig 0.41.3: BSD-2-Clause. https://github.com/xoofx/markdig
YamlDotNet 16.3.0: MIT. https://github.com/aaubry/YamlDotNet
Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions / DependencyInjection.Abstractions: MIT, transitively used by PDFsharp. https://github.com/dotnet/runtime

FFmpeg 9.0.2: LGPL 2.1 or later, GPL/nonfree/network disabled.
LAME 4.0 library: LGPL 2 or later.
Opus 1.6.1: upstream BSD and patent notices.
libwebp 1.6.0: BSD and upstream PATENTS grant.
See engines/ for exact configure flags, license files and engines/sources/ for exact unmodified source archives and reconstruction script. Build dependencies (Ubuntu MinGW/CMake/pkg-config) are not included in the end-user app. Users can replace the LGPL command-line engines in engines/ with compatible builds. No keys, credentials or external service are required for processing.

The installer is created with Inno Setup 6, retaining compiler copyright and license notices in the generated setup. Build/installer compiler is not embedded as a tool for conversions.

PdfPig 0.1.13: Apache-2.0, source commit baeac0d0c344e543ed8b277eac3edd8f8b9c1ac4, license and NOTICES included. https://github.com/UglyToad/PdfPig
Tesseract 5.5.3: Apache-2.0; Leptonica 1.87.0: BSD. Unmodified source archives and reconstruction script in engines/sources; script applies one CMake MinGW library-casing correction (Ws2_32 -> ws2_32).
tessdata_fast eng/spa: Apache-2.0, source commit 87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd. Optional installer task; installed size visible and models removable in Settings. Recognition is local and does not download files.

MinGW compiler runtimes statically linked into the source-built engines: GCC libgcc/libstdc++ under GPLv3 with GCC Runtime Library Exception (copies included), MinGW-w64 runtime notices (including public-domain/per-file licenses and ZPL project license), winpthreads BSD/MIT notices included. These compiler runtime notices do not enable GPL codecs in FFmpeg.

PDF rendering uses PDFtoImage 5.4.0 (MIT), SkiaSharp 4.150.1 (MIT plus native third-party notices) and bblanchon.PDFium.Win32 152.0.7961 (NuGet declares Apache-2.0; release package and PDFium component/third-party licenses included in ThirdParty/PDFium-152.0.7961). Exact Windows DLL matched against the upstream release archive by SHA-256. Build flags disable V8 and XFA. No PDF JavaScript engine is enabled. Windows.Data.Pdf is not used by the shipped PDF rendering path.
